worldcombat.skill.aurawheel.summary: Rolls the energy stored in the user's cheeks along the ground; using it raises Speed, and its type follows the user's form.
The user rolls forward along the ground toward the target and stops at the first creature or obstacle it meets; if that is a foe it takes about %1$s physical damage. It rolls up to %2$s blocks, %3$s blocks per tick, with a collision radius of %4$s blocks. Whether or not it connects, using it raises the user's Speed by %5$s stages; the damage type follows the user's form — Dark in Hangry mode, Electric otherwise.
